title: Good enough while it worked
text: Good enough while it worked. Had for 9 months and it quit working for no apparent reason. Simply a huge disappointment. Warranty work is such a hassle too. I would NOT recommend this to a friend.

product_metadata.title: Soniclean Soft Carpet Vacuum Cleaner
features: Developed with the leading global manufacturer of premium carpet. Designed to easily and properly clean all types of soft style carpets with pile lengths less than 1 inch.

The only vacuum to use patented SONIC CARPET CLEANING TECHNOLOGY. The sonic bar on the bottom of the vacuum produces 200 vibrations per second of high frequency sonic energy that dislodges the deeply embedded dirt and particulate in the carpet pile.
Ultra-soft bristle brushroll, designed to be extra gentle on carpet fibers.

Patented EZ-Push adjustable vent system and lightweight design (weighs only 10.5lbs) allows the vacuum to be easily pushed and pulled across thick carpets. Not for use on shag, frieze or carpets with a pile length over 1 inch tall.
Hospital-grade H13 HEPA filtration system captures 99.97% of particles down to 0.3 microns in size - ideal for allergy sufferers.
description: The Soniclean Soft Carpet upright vacuum cleaner was designed in conjunction with the leading carpet manufacturers to clean soft style carpets such as Caress*, SmartStrand*, Silk*, Soft Spring*, etc. The Soft Carpet upright vacuum received the highest possible performance testing score (CRI Gold Standard) from the Carpet & Rug Institute for carpet care and cleaning performance. This vacuum has unique features that allow soft style carpets to be thoroughly and easily cleaned. The Soniclean Soft Carpet vacuum has a unique vent system on the front of the vacuum – giving the user the ability to dial in the perfect amount of suction for soft style carpeting of various styles, lengths and densities. Unlike most vacuum cleaners that have plastic brush rolls with stiff bristles, the Soniclean Soft Carpet vacuum has an American-made ash wood brush roll with soft nylon bristles, which gently, yet effectively clean soft style carpet fibers. The front wheels on the Soniclean Soft Carpet are extra-large, with a high quality over-molded rubber design, allowing the vacuum to float on the surface of even the densest soft carpets.The Soniclean Soft Carpet vacuum cleaner is the only vacuum cleaner to use patented sonic cleaning technology. The sonic bar on the bottom of the vacuum produces 12,000 vibrations per minute (that’s 200 pulsations per second!) of sonic energy THAT’S PROVEN to enhance the vacuum’s cleaning performance by dislodging the embedded dirt and allergens in the carpet pile. Protect your investment by getting the Soniclean Soft Carpet vacuum, the perfect vacuum to clean your soft carpet and keep it looking great! The Soft Carpet vacuum has HEPA filtration, powerful suction, an energy efficient design, is extremely light-weight, and is the perfect vacuum for not just soft carpet, but regular carpet and hard floors too*! This offer also includes a Soniclean’s powerful 800-watt handheld canister vacuum (included separately) - great for cleaning stairs, furniture, automobiles and more!*The SFC-7000 is not for use on long fiber shag or frieze.SOFT CARPET® Upright Vacuum Features: • Adjustable vent system for easy maneuverability on soft style carpeting • Special soft nylon brush roll bristles – effective, yet gentle on soft style carpeting • Large front wheels – allows the vacuum to float on soft style carpeting for ease of use• Patented Sonic Cleaning Technology • Extreme Suction – Direct Air Design• Digitally Controlled Multi-Speed Motor with DEEP CLEANING & REGULAR Modes• Energy Efficient- uses 50% less electricity than many full-size vacuums (4.6 Amps)• H13 HEPA Sealed Filtration System – Ultra-sanitary dust disposal (Great for allergy sufferers)• Low profile design, lays completely flat for use under low clearance furniture• Jam Protection Feature – vacuum automatically shuts down if brush-roll jam is sensed• Check Bag indicator light lets the user know when it’s time to change the filter• Long power cord – 35 Ft.• OPTIONAL Sonicfresh Fragrance Dispenser – light scent of fresh linens every time you vacuum!• FIVE YEAR MOTOR and ONE YEAR PARTS WARRANTY • LIFETIME BELT WARRANTY • Certified Gold by The Carpet and Rug Institute Handheld Canister Features: • 800 watt motor • 4 to 1 stretch hose • Turbo tool • Floor tool • Upholstery tool • Dusting tool • Crevice tool • Two piece wand • 15 ft. power cord • Shoulder strap • Tote bag for accessories
